chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
There is no obedience to a created being in the disobedience of the Creator.
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for obeying a ruler or person according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This maxim, known as *La Ta'ata li-Makhluqin fi Ma'siyat al-Khaliq*, serves as a cornerstone of Shia jurisprudence, establishing that human authority is derivative and conditional upon divine law. It provides the theological basis for *al-Imam al-'Adil* and is frequently cited in cases of civil disobedience when rulers issue commands contrary to Sharia. The principle underscores that ultimate loyalty belongs to God, rendering any created being's command void if it entails sin.
